headline: Brazil Approves National Roadmap to Halt and Reverse Deforestation by 2030
summary: Ahead of COP31, Brazil approved a national roadmap establishing four fronts of action to halt and reverse deforestation by 2030, while discussions regarding fossil fuels remain pending.
why: Environmental policy frameworks in major forested economies influence international climate commitments and sustainable investment flows.
